==About me==

''The things that I love most is reading, playing football, and just relaxing. The wheel of time series is the best book series that I have read by far. Robert Jordan is a very unique author and uses very descriptive words to make his world your world. It is to bad that he has passed away, I would of really loved to meet him.''
